title: My Gemini texts in paragraphs.
old_caption:
Nine texts from them, one from you, and suddenly you're wondering who cares more. Texting style isn't interest level.
Say your style out loud so nobody has to guess.

title: They said 'lol' to my heartfelt text.
old_caption: You poured your heart into a text and got "lol" back. Ouch. Sometimes people freeze at big feelings over a screen. Before assuming the worst, ask kindly, face to face.

title: Is it too soon to say I like them?
old_caption:
Three dates in and wondering if it's too soon to say you like them? The rulebook committee has opinions, but there's no clock on honesty.
Saying how you feel kindly is never too soon.

title: I roasted Virgos for years. Now I'm dating one.
old_caption:
Years of joking about Virgos in the group chat, and now you're dating one who's lovely. A little humbling, a lot sweet.
Signs are a starting point, not a sentence. Let people surprise you.

title: What's a sun, moon and rising?
old_caption:
Your sun is your core, your moon is what you feel inside, your rising is how you come across. Mom figured it out faster than anyone.
You're more than one sign, and so is everyone you love.

title: Why are there no photos?
old_caption: Mom wants to know why there are no photos. Then she remembers hearing a laugh across a room before she ever saw a face. Getting to know the person first is an old kind of romance.

title: What's a talk card?
old_caption: One question, two answers, nobody peeks: "What's your comfort meal?" Mom's answer made everyone cry. A thoughtful question opens people up in ways a clever line never will.

title: Geminis are two-faced.
old_caption:
That label has followed Geminis around for ages. Turns out it isn't two faces, it's two hundred curious interests.
Asking a good question beats believing a myth about someone.

title: Scorpios are scary.
old_caption:
The spooky shadow turns out to be a Scorpio knitting you a sweater, because you said you get cold in June.
Intense doesn't mean scary. Often it means deeply, quietly loyal.

title: Your sun sign is the whole story.
old_caption:
Your sun sign is only one bright dot. Look closer and there's a moon, a rising, a Venus and more.
You're not one star, you're a whole sky. Get curious about all of it, in yourself and in others.
